remarks: Welcome to this beautifully maintained second-floor unit, featuring stunning millwork, private stairs, and elegant molding throughout. This spacious 2-bedroom, 1-bath home includes four-season sunroom-perfect for relaxing year-round-and an additional room that could serve as a third bedroom or home office. The large kitchen with a pantry opens up to bright and airy spaces, while a private entryway leads to a spacious attic for extra storage. Outside, enjoy a private backyard and a long driveway, along with convenient shared laundry in the basement with ample storage. Just a short walk to SONO, the new SONO Collection Mall, and Metro North, this home is full of charm and unbeatable convenience. Available immediately. No pets or smoking allowed. (Landlord requires good credit, income verification, and references.)
